items.statement: Management confirmed no related-party transactions with Birla Cellulose despite being in the same industry.
items.quote: No, we do not have, because anyway, we report any related party transaction, but we do not have any transactions with them.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance at INR270 crores plus INR125 crores in liquid mutual funds; unutilized fund-based limits of INR427 crores; net debt nil; operating working capital increased due to higher inventory
items.value: INR270 crores cash and bank balance; INR125 crores liquid mutual funds; INR427 crores unutilized limits
items.quote: Bank balances remain at INR270 crores and investment in liquid mutual funds is about INR125 crores. We have an unutilized fund-based limits during the period, which is about INR427 crores. So from a cash position standpoint, the company is adequately covered both with respect to the cash available on hand as well as the limits -- unutilized limits, which are provided by the bank.

items.statement: Chairman acknowledges buying shares 2-4 quarters ago but denies doing so to influence market
items.quote: I did buy something 2, 2/4 before I. But see you. I don't do things to influence the market. Okay.

items.statement: Balance rights issue money of INR200 crores expected this quarter before end of quarter
items.quote: The balance rights issue money of INR200 crores, INR100 crores from the promoter and the balance INR100 crores from others who participated is expected this quarter, before the end of this quarter.

items.statement: Days sales outstanding increased from 58 to 129 days due to slow government approval processes
items.quote: So, typically the governments we all know are a little bit slow in approval processes. So, over the past years we have mastered that art that our liquidity and our work in progress are all aligned considering this delay that happens.
